definitions.gloss: looking after others; taking care of people
definitions.explanation: The habit or ability of looking after other people, especially juniors, newcomers or younger family members. Almost always met in {面倒見|めんどうみ}がいい, said in praise of a caring, dependable person.

examples.english: My older brother is good at looking after people.

examples.japanese: {面倒見|めんどうみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けられた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: I was helped by a senior colleague who takes good care of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{面倒見|めんどうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけて⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: She is caring by nature and speaks up to help as soon as a newcomer is in trouble.

notes:
The noun behind ⟦{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る→面倒を見る：18263_mendouwomiru⟧ (to look after). Typical of praise for a ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧, a boss, a teacher or an older sibling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面倒見|めんどうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / よい: caring, good at looking after people
- {面倒見|めんどうみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: unhelpful to those in one's charge
- {面倒見|めんどうみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a caring person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世話好|せわず}き→世話好き：08719_sewazuki⟧: someone who likes to fuss over and help others, sometimes a little too much
